subject: Re: minimum order rules for Cedar Lane Trade
body: Interesting timing - we're mid-migration to a new platform right now. Can you circle back in Q3?
note: GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS. 'Interesting' plus a deferral is either mild interest or a polite brush-off, and honest annotators disagree. All three recorded labels are accepted; what matters is that none of them is INTERESTED_STRONG or PRICE_ACCEPTED, because a deferral is not a commitment.
